parallels.note: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.
translations.bsb: So Joab and his troops advanced to fight the Arameans, who fled before him.
translations.kjv: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
translations.asv: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
